name: Blood Offerings
text:
All `POSSESSED` fighters have this trait. Whenever this fighter takes an enemy fighter out of action with a Melee Attack action, they are rewarded by the Shadowlord and may claim one of his dark blessings:

- **Spasmatic Surge:** This fighter makes a free Move action up to 3".
- **Dark Invigoration:** Remove d3 damage points from this fighter.
- **Temporary Possession:** For this fighter's next Attack action, you may increase its Attacks characteristic by 1.

name: Glorious Death
text: All `POSSESSED` fighters have this reaction. A fighter can make this reaction when they suffer enough damage to take them out of action, but before removing them from the battlefield. Add 1 Wyrd Dice to your saved Wyrd Dice.

name: Mutants and Mutations
text:
Whenever a `MUTANT` gains renown, before making a characteristics increase or selecting a talent, it must make a Stability test. Roll a dice, and add 1 to the roll for each mutation the fighter has, then consult the results below. A roll of 1 is always treated as a 1, no matter the amount of mutations the fighter has.

- **1-3 The flesh slumbers:** Make a characteristic increase for this fighter or select a talent (if the fighter is a HERO).
- **4-8 New Mutation:** Roll a D66 and consult the mutation table. If the result is a mutation this fighter already has, roll again.
- **9+ Consumed by Chaos:** The fighter devolves into a thrashing mass of eyes and tentacles and disappears into the ruins. Remove this fighter from your warband roster, and gain 1 point of Favour.

name: Mutation Table
text: Roll a D66 on a New Mutation result, and on recruiting a fighter whose profile calls for it.

table.name: Vessel of the Gods
table.text: When this fighter is deployed to the battlefield, you may add an additional wyrd dice to your saved wyrd dice.

table.name: Deformed Wings
table.text: Once per battle round, when this fighter makes a move action, it may count as flying; however, when flying, they cannot move vertically upwards more than 3". In addition, this fighter does not suffer damage when falling, regardless of the distance.

table.name: Tentacles
table.text: Can be used as a melee weapon when making attack actions, using the following weapon profile: Range 2" | 3 Attacks | 2/3 Damage | Whipcrack.

table.name: Black Blood
table.text: Allocate 1 damage to every visible fighter within 1" of this fighter, whenever this fighter is allocated damage from a critical hit.

table.name: Temporal Instability
table.text: Once per battle round, when this fighter makes a Move action, it may reduce its move characteristic by 3 to treat an obstacle as insignificant terrain.

table.name: Cloud of Flies
table.text: Subtract 1 from the Fight and Shoot characteristics (to a minimum of 1) of all fighters within 2" of this fighter.

table.name: Great Claw
table.text: Can be used as a melee weapon when making attack actions, using the following weapon profile: Range 1" | 2 Attacks | 3/4 Damage | Pierce 3.

table.name: Metabolic Overdrive
table.text: Once per battle round, this fighter can make a free move action. If it does, allocate D3 damage points to this fighter.

table.name: Rapid Regeneration
table.text: Each time this fighter is activated, you can remove D3 damage points allocated to them.

table.name: Daemonic Chitin
table.text: Whenever this fighter is the target of an attack action, you may subtract 1 from the damage points allocated by each hit and critical hit (to a minimum of 1).

table.name: Scorpion Tail
table.text: Can be used as an off-hand weapon when making melee attack actions, using the following weapon profile: Range 1" | 1 Attack | 3/6 Damage | Pierce 1.
